claims.claim: MFW, BRICS+ Fashion Summit and Made in Moscow are connected by one platform shell.
The shared shell maintains one profile with event-scoped MFW/BFS registrations and separate Made in Moscow brand verification.
Discover and agenda can span MFW and BFS; Made brands appear only from the verified roster authority.
Deal Room lifecycle is represented as a read-only product contract preview.
Trust Passport is an explainable read-only preview without a universal reputation score.
Five monetisation surfaces and evidence gates are represented without claiming realised ARR/MRR.
Remote public media is source-owned and is not treated as a commercial-use licence.
This investor UI wave does not itself prove production PostgreSQL readiness.

rules: No meeting or request is counted as revenue.
